simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to יָחֵף (H3182) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: יָחֵף (yâchêph) means unsandalled First listed occurrence: 2Sam 15 30.

definitions.full: H3182. yacheph יָחֵף adjective barefoot , always absolute יָחֵף Isa 20:2 4 t.; — וְיָחֵף עָרוֺם הלך 20:2 ( מֵעַל תַחֲלֹץ נַעַלְךָ רַגְּלֶ֑ךָ in preceding clause), 20:3 ; יָחֵף הֹלֵךְ 2Sam 15:30 ; יָחֵף נָהַג Isa 20:3 ; apparently = substantive, מִיָּחֵף רַגְלֵךְ מִנְעִי Jer 2:25 withhold thy foot from bareness (Syriac discalceatio ). יַחְצְאֵלִי יַחֲצִיאֵל, יַחְצְאֵל, see below חצה .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to take off the shoes ;
